mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO signals (market, code, trade_date, strategy, strategy_version, signal_type, indicator_snapshot, run_id, generated_at) VALUES (#{market}, #{code}, #{tradeDate}, #{strategy}, #{strategyVersion}, #{signalType}, #{indicatorSnapshot}, #{runId}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM signals WHERE trade_date = #{tradeDate} ORDER BY market, code

SELECT s.* FROM signals s JOIN ( SELECT market, code, strategy, MAX(trade_date) AS md FROM signals GROUP BY market, code, strategy ) t ON s.market = t.market AND s.code = t.code AND s.strategy = t.strategy AND s.trade_date = t.md ORDER BY s.trade_date DESC, s.market, s.code
